cohort: The study included 240 Chinese women who received lower segment caesarean section surgeries.
finding: Specific genotypes of MDR1 (TT), CYP3A4 (*1G/*1G), and OPRM1 (GG) genes were significantly associated with altered post-operative fentanyl consumption and physiological effects in Chinese women after caesarean section, though adverse reactions did not differ by genotype.
